title: The Lantern Beneath Hawthorn Hollow
target_audience: English-speaking US, UK, Canadian, and Australian viewers
hooks: Every autumn in the British hills, hikers spot tiny brass lanterns glowing beneath hawthorn roots.
When frost hits the hollow, one acorn-sized keeper has eight seconds before the last ember dies.
Look closely inside this mossy oak root—someone left the porch light on.

Warm amber focal point (glowing lantern or magical spore) contrasted against deep twilight blue/frosty teal shadows. Clean centered composition, highly expressive non-human sprite character, zero on-screen text. Coherent lighting, consistent proportions in every shot, zero on-screen text.
script: Every autumn in the British hills, hikers spot tiny brass lanterns glowing beneath hawthorn roots. Wick shelters his dying lantern flame from a sudden frost gust and revives it with a rare dried sun-berry. Watch how this tiny mechanism unfolds.

scenes.name: Glowing Root Discovery
scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16 macro tilt-shift camera pushes into mossy hollow where Wick holds a glowing brass lantern, twilight mist.

scenes.name: Frost Wave
scenes.prompt: Silver frost crystals race across emerald moss; a gust nearly snuffs Wick's flame down to a dying ember.

scenes.name: Sun-Berry Spark
scenes.prompt: Wick feeds a luminous dried golden berry into the lantern; warm amber light erupts softly.

scenes.name: Sanctuary
scenes.prompt: Warm golden light fills the root archway, guiding tiny woodland beetles safely in from the freezing night.
